newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR ENGLAND V S.AFRICA INTERNATIONAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR ENGLAND V S.AFRICA INTERNATIONAL.

text.p: Teams for the first-ever soccer international between England and African champions South Africa at Old Trafford on Saturday:

England: 1-Nigel Martyn; 2-Philip Neville, 4-Martin Keown, 5- Gareth Southgate, 3-Stuart Pearce, 6-Graeme Le Saux, 7-Jamie Redknapp, 11-Robert Lee, 8-Paul Gascoigne, 9-Ian Wright, 10- Teddy Sheringham

South Africa: 1-Andre Arendse; 2-Sizwe Moutaung, 5-Mark Fish, 9-Neil Tovey, 19-Lucas Radebe, 15-Doctor Khumalo, 21-Eric Tinkler, 18-John Moeti, 10-John Moshoeu, 6-Philemon Masinga, 12-Brendan Augustine
